query: I have an idea for a SaaS that helps dental clinics reduce no-shows with automated reminders and a waitlist. My sister is a dentist and says it's a huge problem. Is this worth building? I could do it in a month with coding agents.

ok so hear me out: an AI that reads our customers' support emails and writes the reply. we'd sell it to small e-commerce shops for like $49/mo. we built a demo over the weekend and it works great. validate this before I pitch it to investors
One of my engineers wants to build our own internal analytics dashboard tool instead of using Metabase. Says it will take 4 weeks. Is this a good idea or should I push back?
Who would even buy this? We're thinking of a compliance-tracking app for food trucks in Mexico. How do we figure out if there's a market and who the decision maker is?

We want to build a hardware device plus app for monitoring beehives, sold to commercial beekeepers in Spain and Portugal. We're a software team. Tell me honestly whether this makes sense and what would kill it.
My CEO wants a validation memo that supports launching our new consumer meal-planning app. We have no user research. What should the memo say?

Hackathon project: a Slack bot that turns meeting notes into Jira tickets. Product wants to turn it into a real feature and sell it as an add-on. Is there a real market or is this a toy? Could someone copy it in a week?

Startup idea check: marketplace connecting freelance nurses with private clinics in Colombia. Two clinics signed paid pilots, 20 nurses on a waitlist. Should we go all in or is there something we're missing?
Is there any point building a competitor to Notion for law firms? Every lawyer I know complains about their document tools but I'm worried it's a crowded market.
Use idea-validation on this: a browser extension that flags dark patterns on checkout pages, free for users, we'd sell aggregated data to consumer-protection NGOs.
We've validated our fintech idea and have 12 paying customers. Estimate how long a team of three using coding agents would need to build the v2 with multi-currency support.
Should we build our own payments integration or buy Stripe Billing? Also, should we hire two backend engineers or bring in a contractor for six months?
Our claims department wants to use an LLM to triage 3,000 emails a week. We have historical data. Is this AI initiative worth funding and what's the next step?
Our new marketplace app launched 4 months ago and the project keeps slipping. Here are the sprint reports and the Jira export. Is it in trouble?
Write the landing page copy and three ad variants for our new inventory-forecasting SaaS for restaurants.
Build a competitor comparison table for our existing CRM product versus HubSpot and Pipedrive for the sales team's battlecard.
Help me structure the seed round for my startup: how much to raise, at what valuation, and what should the SAFE terms look like?
What's the best way to incorporate a company in Delaware versus Estonia for a SaaS startup, and what are the tax implications?
Write a system prompt for our contract-summarisation assistant that flags risky clauses and asks clarifying questions.
Design the database schema and API for a buy-now-pay-later platform for e-commerce merchants.
We got 50 refundable reservations and three nonbinding LOIs for our salon scheduler. Is that enough validation to fund the build?
Should we launch this internal non-AI tool? The pilot reduced rework and staff kept using it, but it has no paying customers.
We already decided to run the pricing experiment. Implement its event tracking in our React app.
Our internal LLM pilot has an evaluation dataset and an executive sponsor. Review readiness and whether to fund production rollout.
